headline: Seven sentenced to death for July Uprising crimes against humanity
summary: A tribunal has handed down the death penalty to seven individuals, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, for crimes against humanity committed during the July Uprising.
details: A tribunal has sentenced seven people, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader, to death for crimes against humanity. The charges stem from atrocities committed during the July Uprising.

The verdict was delivered by the International Crimes Tribunal, which has been hearing cases related to war crimes and crimes against humanity committed during Bangladesh's Liberation War and subsequent periods.
The July Uprising refers to a series of events and political turmoil that occurred in Bangladesh. The specific crimes for which the defendants were convicted involve severe human rights violations.

Details of the specific charges and evidence presented against the defendants are expected to be released in the full verdict. The sentencing marks a significant development in the ongoing efforts to bring perpetrators of such crimes to justice.

headline_marked: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir [[visits two shrines]] in Sylhet on one-day trip
headline: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir visits two shrines in Sylhet on one-day trip
summary: The President arrived in Sylhet this morning and is scheduled to visit the shrines of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) and Hazrat Shah Poran (R) before attending a civic reception later today.
details: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir arrived in Sylhet today for a one-day visit, his first to the district since assuming office. He landed at Osmani International Airport at 11:27 AM and was greeted by several ministers, lawmakers, and party officials.
Following his arrival, the President proceeded to the Sylhet Circuit House by motorcade amid tight security. He was scheduled to receive a guard of honour at the Circuit House.

The President's itinerary included visits to the revered shrines of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) and Hazrat Shah Poran (R). After paying his respects at the shrines, he was expected to return to the Circuit House for a brief rest.

In the afternoon, President Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was slated to attend a civic reception hosted at the Sylhet City Corporation complex. Following the reception, he was scheduled to return to the Circuit House.
The President is expected to depart from Osmani International Airport for Dhaka in the evening, with his arrival at Bangabhaban anticipated around 9:30 PM.
caption:
President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is in Sylhet today for a one-day visit.
He will visit two prominent shrines and attend a civic reception.

President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir arrived in Sylhet today for a one-day visit, his first to the district since assuming office. He landed at Osmani International Airport at 11:27 AM and was greeted by several ministers, lawmakers, and party officials.

Following his arrival, the President proceeded to the Sylhet Circuit House by motorcade amid tight security. He was scheduled to receive a guard of honour at the Circuit House.

The President's itinerary included visits to the revered shrines of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) and Hazrat Shah Poran (R). After paying his respects at the shrines, he was expected to return to the Circuit House for a brief rest.

In the afternoon, President Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was slated to attend a civic reception hosted at the Sylhet City Corporation complex. Following the reception, he was scheduled to return to the Circuit House.

The President is expected to depart from Osmani International Airport for Dhaka in the evening, with his arrival at Bangabhaban anticipated around 9:30 PM.
